parsed.note_claim: The real Tesla Roadster only performs short jumps of about 5–6 seconds with cold-gas thrusters (no prolonged hover).
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: Tesla has demonstrated its Roadster electric car using cold-gas thrusters, developed in collaboration with SpaceX, launching—and performing an axial roll in the air—on a short hop.
parsed.reason: The article confirms the real demonstration was a 'short hop' using cold-gas thrusters, substantiating the note's claim that the vehicle does not perform prolonged hovers.
